text: The pipeline is built, monitored, and adopted -- now it has to survive without anyone standing next to it. Three documents make that possible, and none of them do the same job.

A plain-English dictionary entry for Inventory Depletion Rate, stating exactly what it excludes. A prose lineage anyone can follow. And a Task-monitoring runbook that isn't theoretical -- it's the literal sequence that found the real incident.
Every honest hop in this chain, from a store's point-of-sale export all the way to the Power BI dashboard, lands inside the thirty-minute freshness target signed off earlier in this series.
The runbook is ordered on purpose: check if data is arriving first, then whether it's piling up unconsumed, then whether the Task itself is suspended -- cheapest check first, most likely cause last.
Documented, not just built. Next: the honest closing video -- what genuinely changed, and what's still manual.
